root_cause: The self-hosted runner lost network connectivity to GitHub's artifact service endpoints when trying to download the 'openvino_package' artifact. The ECONNREFUSED error indicates the TCP connection was actively refused, likely due to a transient runner networking issue, a GitHub Actions backend blip, or a runner-level proxy/firewall interruption. This is unrelated to the PR code changes.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed 'Samples / Samples' job — transient ECONNREFUSED failures resolve on retry
Check runner health if the failure persists across multiple retries
prevention_strategies: Implement retry logic in the custom download-artifact action for ECONNREFUSED transient errors.
historical_context: This exact pattern (ECONNREFUSED on ListArtifacts) has occurred 4 times total (first seen 2026-07-01). Prior occurrences on runs 29522352360, 29426291440, 28532884711 all resolved on re-run.
